summary: Form left and hotline numbers right on a blurred office ground, then office cards by region. No head band. Needs four phone numbers and two to four office addresses.

sections.note: no band: the H1 and the form start straight under the header

left a serif H1, first and last name, business email, phone, company, country select, message, a privacy line, a captcha and a Book Now button; right a serif Hotlines heading and four country names each with a large number
Corporate office contact information: serif heading and white cards with a region name and an address, over a faint ground
